notes.title: Glassbreakers | Open Beta Patch 0.6
notes.content:
Hello Glassbreakers!

We have made the following changes:

[h1]New Features[/h1]
[h2]Lobby Tutorial[/h2]
[i]We’ve added some tutorial features to help new players navigate around the Attic. Let us know what you think in the Glassbreakers Discord![/i]

[h1]Bug Fixes[/h1]
[list]
[*] We have resolved an issue for the Daily Quest Countdown timer displaying the wrong time depending on when and where you complete a quest.
[*] We have resolved an issue where the Daily Quest for breaking Glass only credits for two when breaking all three in an AI match.
[*] (Steam) We have resolved an issue impacting in-app purchasing.
[*] We have resolved an issue impacting Champion stats not appearing correct at the end of matches.
[/list]

notes.title: Glassbreakers | Open Beta Patch 0.5
notes.content:
Hello Glassbreakers!

We have made the following changes:

[h1]Balance Changes[/h1]
[h2]Champions[/h2]
[h3]Gwendoline[/h3]
[i]While Gwendoline has great survivability on her own, we're not seeing her ability have as much of an impact as we hoped it would. We're increasing both her starting redirection amount and the amount she redirects at max level. Our hope is this gives her team a bit more lasting power in team fights.[/i]
[list]
[*]Significantly increased the amount of damage redirected from allies while King's Protection is active.
[/list]
[h3]Barnard[/h3]
[i]Last balance patch we increased Barnard's starting health to give him better survivability in the early game. We knew we needed to do more to make him feel like he can compete with Brel but needed more time to find the right change. In the end we found that both Radiant Blast and Barnard's attack needed a bit of love. Our hope is that these increases in damage will help Barnard compete with Brel for a spot when you are composing your squad.[/i]
[list]
[*]Slightly increased starting attack damage.
[*]Slightly increased attack damage gained per level.
[*]Increased Radiant Blast's starting damage and damage gained per level.
[/list]

[h1]Bug Fixes[/h1]

[list]
[*] Players should no longer have the wrong name highlighted on the Leaderboard if you have a tied score.
[*] Steam players should no longer be offset.
[/list]

notes.title: Glassbreakers | Open Beta Patch 0.4
notes.content:
[h1]Open Beta Patch 0.4[/h1]

Hello Glassbreakers! 

[b]We will be taking the servers offline for two hours on October 17, 2023 9:00 PM Pacific to make the following changes.[/b]

[h1]Event: Halloween Spooktacular[/h1]
[h2]🎃  Spooky Store Content[/h2]
Witching hour is approaching, and so is our bewitching Halloween lineup! Get ready to cast a spell with an eerie collection of Masks, Dyes, and limited time emblems!
[h2]👻  Bonus Champion Mastery XP[/h2]
This Halloween, it's not just the spirits rising! Join our Champion Mastery XP event from Oct 27 to 31 and earn bonus Champion Mastery XP with every victory.
[h2]🔮  Discord Events and More[/h2]
Something wicked is coming to the Glassbreakers Discord this Halloween. Join us on October 31, from 10 AM - 2 PM Pacific, as we host an afternoon of pumpkin carving, costume contests, and more!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44566656/2fbd7a6532a739f9b97734f343715c4b57d2d1ad.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44566656/5757dcef21c3edd44a96d9c6a0d7563ac7bc2f9c.png[/img]
[h1]New Features and Improvements[/h1]

[h2]Leaderboards Are Here[/h2]
[i]Player Ranks are on the way, but in the mean time we are bringing leaderboards to Glassbreakers! You can now see how you stack up against other players. To access the Leaderboard, open the System Menu while in the Attic.[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44566656/e2f69ca26fea5b90ac8f9c93c04421979159b530.png[/img]
[h2]Smarter AI[/h2]
[i]In this update, Skynet is taking over! One of the most requested features is more engaging matches with our AI. While we still have a lot of work to do, our first improvements are going into this update. The AI will now have profiles: for newer players, the starting AI will not get harder, while for more advanced players, the AI should no longer allow you to simply walk right into their base and get their Glass.[/i]
[i]Along with this change, we have reduced the time it takes for idle Champions to attack nearby enemy targets. Overall we have found this makes the game feel smoother in several areas.[/i]
[h2]Quests[/h2]
[i]In their current state, quests can feel a little confusing. We wanted to have a concept for “normal” and “hard” quests but this is not coming across as well as we hoped. For now, we are going to pare down the quests to provide more consistency. Look for more, exciting quests being implemented in the future![/i]

[h1]Bug Fixes[/h1]
[list]
[*]Fixed an issue where Default Dye was not being applied properly in the Lobby.
[/list]

notes.title: The Glassbreakers Open Beta is LIVE on Steam VR!
notes.content:
Dear readers, adventurers of Moss, and VR enthusiasts—we're thrilled to announce the [i]Glassbreakers[/i] Open Beta is now live on Steam VR!

Our dedicated team has been hard at work to bring [i]Glassbreakers[/i] to the Steam platform and couldn’t be more excited to share the next phase of [i]Glassbreakers[/i] with you. Starting today, we’ve lifted the player cap so Steam [u][/u][b]players with SteamVR-compatible headsets, including Quest 2, Quest 3, Quest Pro, Rift, Index, and HTC Vive[/b], can now download and dive into the heart-pounding action of the Glassbreakers Open Beta. The best news? [b]Both Steam and App Lab players can battle against each other thanks to crossplay[/b]!

[h2]Important Notes[/h2]
[list]
[*][b]Crossplay is on. [/b]You’ll be playing with Glassbreakers players across all supported devices.  
[*][b]Account linking isn't implemented YET, but rest assured it’s on our roadmap![/b] This means Meta players are unable to transfer their progress to Steam and vice versa. Stay tuned. 
[*]Speaking of [b]development roadmaps[/b], exciting updates are on the horizon! Check out the roadmap to get a sneak peek of what we're currently working on!
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44566656/3f30cf24d5e65e01a8fae604445e2ff0e39604ff.png[/img]

We want to extend our heartfelt thanks and give a shoutout to our dedicated community, whose support has been instrumental in shaping Glassbreakers into an exceptional, first-of-its-kind experience in VR. Your feedback and enthusiasm have been the wind beneath our wings, and we're excited to continue this journey together. 🥂

[h2]We Want to Hear From You![/h2]

We’re listening and prioritizing our development schedule to reflect your input and we can’t wait to bring even more exciting content your way leading up to and with the release of Season 1. In the meantime, we’d love to hear from you, so please leave us a comment, review, or join our active Glassbreakers community on Discord!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44566656/1677a58cee067ee853dba892341eb70423b08d1d.png[/img]


🔗[url=https://discord.gg/glassbreakersgame]Join the Glassbreakers Discord community[/url]
🔗[url=https://twitter.com/glassbreakersvr]Follow Glassbreakers on Twitter[/url]
🔗[url=https://www.tiktok.com/@glassbreakersgame]Follow Glassbreakers on TikTok[/url]
🔗[url=https://www.twitch.tv/glassbreakersgame]Check out Glassbreakers on Twitch[/url]
🔗[url=https://instagram.com/glassbreakersgame]Follow Glassbreakers on Instagram[/url]

Remember, luck favors the brave, and may the Glass break your way! 🌟🛡️🔮🗡️
